reasons.U1: Only a Default state with '규칙 3줄과 첫 게임 시작', a '규칙·도움말' button and the always-on '모의 대국 N회 기준' label; no beginner onboarding, first-turn guide or explanation of how to read heatmap/rings/numbers.
reasons.U2: Keeps select-then-confirm 2-step placement; row click 'selects, does not place' and shows preview; 'H8에 두기' confirm, undo, off-candidate cell analysed on selection, can place during analysis (sec 3, FLOW-1); touch vs mouse not explicitly distinguished.

reasons.U4: FLOW-1 narrates the turn from the user's side: look at heatmap/ranking, select a cell to see replies and preview, confirm, see 'n순위·%' record, then '백이 두는 중…' auto reply.

reasons.R3: Eleven ranked questions with recommendations explicitly marked not authoritative until user answers; only local reversible details left to the agent (sec 3).
